claims.claim_text: The section describes processes used to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor climate-related risks and explains how these are captured in a climate risk register and integrated into ERM.
claims.support_notes: Narrative description in the section explicitly covers identification/assessment/prioritisation/monitoring and integration into ERM.

claims.claim_text: The entity identifies climate-related risks across its operations and financing activities, including exposures arising through lending and counterparties, and maps climate-risk considerations across parts of the value chain.
claims.support_notes: Stated directly in subsection 1 on identification and value-chain considerations.

claims.claim_text: Operations and travel generate Scope 1–2 emissions and face physical disruption.
Lending to the sector "Other mining and quarrying" carries elevated transition risk from carbon pricing and demand shifts.
Physical risk exposure assessment uses external climate indicator inputs, and physical risk exposure records reference ECB climate indicators as the data source.
claims.support_notes: Subsection 2 states ECB climate indicators are referenced as the data source.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related scenario analysis is referenced in the climate risk register through explicit links to scenario analysis identifiers, including SCN0009, SCN0007, SCN0011 and SCN0005, and these links connect scenario outputs to specific risks as an input to identification and/or assessment.
claims.support_notes: Narrative lists scenario IDs; evidence item confirms at least SCN0009 appears in the register.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are assessed using a structured scoring approach that includes likelihood scoring; likelihood scores recorded in the climate risk register include 3, 4 and 5.
claims.support_notes: Narrative asserts scores 3/4/5; evidence item confirms at least score 4 exists.

claims.claim_text: Risk rating is derived from a 5x5 risk matrix using likelihood_score * severity_score with thresholds: low < 3, medium >= 3, high >= 8, critical >= 15 (scores 1-2 low, 3-6 medium, 8-12 high, 15-25 critical).
claims.support_notes: Methodology and quantitative thresholds are explicitly stated in subsection 4.

claims.claim_text: Consistent with the stated methodology, the climate risk register includes risks rated "medium".
claims.support_notes: The narrative asserts presence of "medium" ratings but no provided evidence item shows a risk_rating field/value.

claims.claim_text: The climate risk register includes a documented physical risk example: chronic heat and shifting precipitation reduce yields for agricultural counterparties, weakening repayment capacity over the medium term.
claims.support_notes: Example text appears in the section; evidence item preview indicates the same description exists in the register.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risk management is integrated into the entity’s overall ERM process for many climate-related risks; the climate risk register includes an ERM integration indicator recorded as True for multiple risks.
claims.support_notes: Narrative claims integration for many risks; evidence confirms at least one True flag, but "multiple" is not directly evidenced in provided items.

claims.claim_text: ERM integration is not universal: at least one climate-related risk is recorded with the ERM integration indicator set to False.
claims.support_notes: Narrative asserts existence of at least one False flag; no provided evidence item shows an ERM integration indicator value of False.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are monitored at different frequencies depending on the risk; monitoring frequencies evidenced include monthly, quarterly and semi-annual.
claims.support_notes: Narrative lists three frequencies; evidence confirms at least monthly exists, but quarterly and semi-annual are not evidenced in provided items.

claims.claim_text: The climate risk register includes an indicator of whether a risk has changed since the prior reporting period, with some entries recorded as True and others as False.
claims.support_notes: Narrative asserts both True and False exist; evidence confirms at least one False exists, but True is not evidenced in provided items.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related opportunities are considered alongside climate-related risks within the entity’s risk management processes, including identification, assessment, prioritisation and monitoring through the same overarching approach.
claims.support_notes: Explicit statement in subsection 9; no specific opportunity examples or scenario-use details are provided beyond the general claim.
